title: File changes in a named worktree outside the workdir are dropped during the completion grace window: turn close clears the observed source root before file tracking finishes
outcome: A turn's source-root and naming scope stays frozen for its file-change tracking through completion and the grace window. A debounced file event in the turn's named root that arrives just after completion is still attributed to that turn and produces the late FileChanges summary, and a batch captured before completion is not turned into Unresolved merely because the observation trace was closed.
acceptance: A behavioural test: a root session working in a named linked worktree outside its own workdir completes a turn through the ACTUAL observation close; a file event in the named root arriving inside the completion grace window yields the late FileChanges summary for that turn (not dropped)
A behavioural test: a file-change batch captured before completion and applied after the observation close keeps its resolution (not Unresolved) when turn ownership is unchanged
The completion fixtures exercise the real observation close, not only finish_active_turn_file_change_tracking with the trace left alive
